product_one_liner: Search a rare disease and follow sourced connections to related biology, communities, and research assets.
landing_disclaimer: This atlas focuses on sourced research connections and reusable assets — not treatment advice. ARID1B-RD currently has no approved disease-modifying therapy in this curated layer.

search_entries.label: ARID1B-related disorder (ARID1B-RD)
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Gene-centered umbrella spanning CSS-like and less syndromic ID presentations.

search_entries.label: Coffin-Siris syndrome 1 (CSS1)
search_entries.disambiguation_note: ARID1B-linked CSS subtype (OMIM 135900). Other genes can cause CSS clinically.

search_entries.label: ARID1B-related nonsyndromic intellectual disability
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Keep distinct from classic CSS1 physical framing.

search_entries.label: ARID1B p.Arg1225Ter
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Representative ClinVar nonsense example (c.3673C>T on NM_001374828.1).

search_entries.label: ARID1B c.4479G>A (splice)
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Synonymous-looking coding change with reported splice/RNA effect.

search_entries.label: ARID1B haploinsufficiency
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Disease-mechanism framing for heterozygous LoF-class patterns.

search_entries.label: CARE4ARID1B natural history study
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Multi-site prospective natural-history study — not a treatment trial.

stages.label: Understand the connection
stages.summary: Follow ARID1B-RD to haploinsufficiency/BAF biology and the CSS1 vs nonsyndromic ID spectrum.

stages.label: Explore resources
stages.summary: See the spectrum publication, CARE4ARID1B natural-history asset, and FAR — with explicit non-treatment framing.

stages.label: Prepare next step
stages.summary: Turn endpoint and spectrum uncertainties into a sourced collaboration brief.
